definitions: A soft sucking sound made when treading in mud or wet ground.
A sound made by or as if by something soft and wet being pressed or crushed.
A device in a radio receiver that suppresses weak signals or noise when no strong signal is being received.
examples: The squelch of his boots in the mud was the only sound.
She heard a squelch as the fruit was crushed.
He adjusted the squelch on the radio.
